segments.text: I received a provisional offer from the School of Computer Science and Engineering at Beihang University! Congratulations also to my supercomputing teammates on their offers from Peking University, Zhejiang University and the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences. Congratulations to all of us!
ThinkLeap, which I co-authored during my research internship at Tsinghua,
were accepted to the EMNLP 2026 main conference!
was accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026! So happy!
Completed my research internship at USTC, working on unified multimodal embeddings for MMEB v2.

Completed my research internship at Tsinghua University, where I worked on efficient LLM reasoning and diffusion language models. We collaborated on four papers in total. It was a wonderful collaboration!
Our Fuzhou University Supercomputing Team received Second Prize at ASC26, ranking 35th globally! Congratulations to all of us!
